description: This file defines the UserLocation class within the Goteo project. It manages user location data, including methods to retrieve user location information and check permissions for viewing and editing the location.

classes.name: UserLocation
classes.description: A model class representing a user's location data, extending LocationItem, providing methods for location management and access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a UserLocation instance, setting the user ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a UserLocation instance for a specified user, accepting either a User object or a user ID.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Checks if a given user can view the location, based on ownership or impersonation rights.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks if a given user can edit the location, using the same check as 'userCanView'.
